free_tier.stated: Free plan: 3 editors, 5 projects, Basic machine (5 GB RAM, 2 vCPU) unlimited. No free-tier disk figure is published anywhere on the pricing page or docs.

egress.terms: Not published; no per-GB transfer price on the pricing page.

tooling: Notebook API, git sync, terminal; `/work` is a normal POSIX directory backed by object storage.
chaining: 5 projects x (undisclosed GB) x N free accounts. The project cap is the hard multiplier ceiling.
limits_note: 100 MB per file via the web upload UI; /work is object-storage-backed and slow for many small files; /tmp is fast but lost on restart; 7-day revision history on Free.
reliability_note: /work does persist across restarts (docs contrast it with /tmp, which 'will be lost when the machine restarts'), but the capacity is unpublished and the 5-project cap makes this uninteresting.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: Free: 3 editors, 5 projects, 'Basic (5 GB RAM, 2 vCPU) unlimited'
'/work is backed by object storage'; '/tmp ... will be lost when the machine restarts'; 100 MB web upload cap

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
